extraction.text:
Sanjog Maheshwari

Data Scientist (8~ Years Experience)
 📞 8989018091 | ✉️ Sanjog.maheshwari@yahoo.com
 📍 India

PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY

Results-driven Data Scientist with over 8~ years of experience designing and deploying AI/ML solutions across financial and enterprise environments. Expert in Machine Learning, Deep Learning, and NLP with hands-on proficiency in Python, BERT, PyTorch, and end-to-end cloud development on AWS. Adept at architecting scalable ML pipelines, API-driven systems, and real-time data processing workflows. Recognized for strong problem-solving skills, cross-functional collaboration, and delivering production-grade AI applications that enhance efficiency, compliance, and decision-making..

CORE SKILLS

Machine Learning: Python, Pandas, Numpy, ML Pipelines, Evaluation

Deep Learning / NLP: BERT, TensorFlow, PyTorch, NLTK, CNN, OCR

Cloud & MLOps: AWS Sagemaker, Pipelines, Endpoints, CloudWatch, RTI

Frameworks: Flask, FastAPI, Web Scraping

Databases: SQL, SQLite3, IBM DB2

Tools: Git, Jupyter Notebook, PyCharm, Google Colab

Deployment: AWS Cloud, API Development, Model Serving

PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE

Senior Developer — HCL Technologies Ltd., Gurugram

April 2022 – Present

Experienced in building GenAI-based document intelligence systems, including extraction, reasoning, and compliance classification using LLMs.

Developed an end-to-end pipeline for Companies House UK streaming and on-demand APIs, combining real-time ingestion with GenAI-powered officer/PSC document interpretation.

Skilled in integrating LLMs with structured and unstructured data, enabling automated insights from filings, ownership documents, and regulatory reports.

Strong understanding of streaming architectures, async processing, and high-throughput data pipelines using Python (AsyncIO, MultiProcessing), FastAPI, and AWS services.

Proven ability to deploy ML and GenAI systems into production with monitoring, logging, and scalable API interfaces.

Known for collaboration, leadership, and delivering AI systems that improve compliance, operational efficiency, and decision intelligence.



Senior Analyst — Allianz Technology, Pune

May 2018 – April 2022

Identified and curated datasets for building predictive models addressing operational and business challenges.

Designed metrics engines for data collection, processing, and performance reporting.

Collaborated cross-functionally to translate business problems into ML modeling solutions.

Developed analytical dashboards and model insights to support strategic decisions.

Associate Engineer — Sears Holdings India, Pune

August 2017 – January 2018

Contributed to the development of multiple web applications for retail business units.

Worked both independently and in team environments to propose and implement solutions.

PROJECTS

1. Companies House UK Data Streaming + Gen AI Officer Document Intelligence (Added Project)

Technology: Python, AsyncIO, FastAPI, AWS, GenAI, OpenAI, Pandas, SQL

Integrated with Companies House UK streaming endpoints to continuously ingest real-time company updates.

Implemented on-demand API ingestion for targeted company lookups.

Built a processing layer to extract officer details, ownership structure, control percentage, and filing events.

Utilized GenAI models to interpret unstructured documents (PDFs, filings, appointment documents) and derive structured insights.

Designed a rules + LLM hybrid engine to determine Persons With Significant Control (PSC) and produce compliance-ready summaries.

Delivered a fully automated pipeline from ingestion → transformation → GenAI extraction → reporting.

2. Carbon Emission Scoring Calculator – NatWest

Technology: Python, AWS SageMaker (Notebook, Pipelines, Endpoints), CloudWatch, RTI

Developed an ML-powered carbon emission calculator for front-desk teams to evaluate reduction strategies for SMEs and enterprises.

Implemented AWS SageMaker pipelines for automated model deployment and monitoring.

Integrated RTI endpoint for real-time predictions.

3. Named Entity Recognition System – NatWest

Technology: BERT, PyTorch, Flask, NLTK, SQL



Built a BERT-based NER system to detect UK account numbers and sort codes from financial documents.

Designed a REST API using Flask for real-time inference and integration into existing systems.

Improved extraction accuracy through preprocessing, token classification, and confidence scoring.

EDUCATION

Bachelor of Engineering (Electronics and Communication), LNCTE, Bhopal

August 2012 — April 2016

HSC, SMIC, Mauranipur

July 2008 — April 2009

SSC, SMIC, Mauranipur

July 2006 — April 2007

ADDITIONAL INFORMATION

Experience deploying ML models into cloud production environments.

Strong communicator, known for collaboration and cross-team problem solving.

Quick learner with interest in Generative AI, streaming data systems, and financial domain ML

sections.label: Projects
sections.text:
PROJECTS
1. Companies House UK Data Streaming + Gen AI Officer Document Intelligence (Added Project)
Technology: Python, AsyncIO, FastAPI, AWS, GenAI, OpenAI, Pandas, SQL
Integrated with Companies House UK streaming endpoints to continuously ingest real-time company updates.
Implemented on-demand API ingestion for targeted company lookups.
Built a processing layer to extract officer details, ownership structure, control percentage, and filing events.
Utilized GenAI models to interpret unstructured documents (PDFs, filings, appointment documents) and derive structured insights.
Designed a rules + LLM hybrid engine to determine Persons With Significant Control (PSC) and produce compliance-ready summaries.
Delivered a fully automated pipeline from ingestion → transformation → GenAI extraction → reporting.
2. Carbon Emission Scoring Calculator – NatWest
Technology: Python, AWS SageMaker (Notebook, Pipelines, Endpoints), CloudWatch, RTI
Developed an ML-powered carbon emission calculator for front-desk teams to evaluate reduction strategies for SMEs and enterprises.
Implemented AWS SageMaker pipelines for automated model deployment and monitoring.
Integrated RTI endpoint for real-time predictions.
3. Named Entity Recognition System – NatWest
Technology: BERT, PyTorch, Flask, NLTK, SQL
Built a BERT-based NER system to detect UK account numbers and sort codes from financial documents.
Designed a REST API using Flask for real-time inference and integration into existing systems.
Improved extraction accuracy through preprocessing, token classification, and confidence scoring.
